references.observation: 2023 remake model view, corresponding to the retained helmet, collar, chest scars, waist belt and both claw gauntlets. Both boots and the tips of all large metal claw blades fit inside the859x859frame. No head/body splice is needed.
limitations: This is a documentary model image, not a certified native game mesh or original combat frame.

references.observation: Full standing/hunched Crimson Head with the same torn brown blazer, exposed chest and dark hair as the retained catalogue crop. Both hands, long fingers, trousers and both bare feet are visible and terminate inside the frame.
limitations: The article identifies the Crimson Head as added in the2002remake. This is a public image reference; exact native platform/dump provenance is not certified.

references.observation: The large full illustration is the exact same upper-body artwork as the retained catalogue crop. The full1772x4093image includes the small fist, entire enlarged claw, both shins and both complete feet, with all tips inside the white frame.
limitations: This is an illustration of the original-game T-002, not a native3D frame. Its catalogue correspondence is verified; no geometric or original-pixel1:1certificate is claimed.

references.observation: Collage of brown and white Eliminators. The white specimen corresponding to the retained catalogue appearance is only visible through the torso and partial arms; lower body is cut.
limitations: Not a complete body reference for the white target.

references.observation: Two full brown-furred Eliminators show their complete limbs and support geometry. The foreground figure has both fore-hands and hind-feet visible.
limitations: The retained catalogue is the white/albino-looking fur variant; this brown-furred source does not certify the exact lower-body coloration or all variant-specific surface markings. Do not silently replace the white target by the brown version.

references.observation: Full green Hunter render shows all hands, claw tips, feet and dorsal spikes within the frame. The accompanying article section covers both HunterR and the smaller HunterMu.
limitations: This first render is not individually attributed to the Mu variant. Do not infer that the complete HunterR anatomy/proportions are an exact Mu source solely from the shared section heading.
